text: The expensive model should see the fewest documents. Most of the work is knowing what never needed it.
author: Mikhail Agladze
gloss: Route the easy cases cheaply. Save the heavy machinery for the ones that actually earn it.

text: A system that works in the demo and not on Tuesday morning was never a system.
author: Mikhail Agladze

text: Every number on a slide should survive someone asking where it came from.
author: Mikhail Agladze

text: Retrieval is not search. Search finds documents; retrieval finds the sentence that settles the question.
author: Mikhail Agladze
gloss: Returning ten plausible pages is not an answer. Returning the line that decides it is.

text: Automation earns trust the way people do — by being boring for a long time.
author: Mikhail Agladze

text: If the pipeline needs someone watching it, you built a job, not a pipeline.
author: Mikhail Agladze

text: The hard part was never the model. It was the twelve upstream systems that disagree about what a customer is.
author: Mikhail Agladze
gloss: Most AI projects are data-reconciliation projects wearing a better jacket.

text: Teaching a thing is how you find out whether you understood it.
author: Mikhail Agladze
